summary: Credit Linked Subsidy (CLSS) of up to ₹2.67 Lakh or affordable housing allotment for homeless EWS/LIG families.

steps.title: Verify EWS/LIG income category
steps.description: Annual family income up to ₹3 Lakh for Economically Weaker Section (EWS); up to ₹6 Lakh for Low Income Group (LIG).

steps.title: Pucca house non-ownership affidavit
steps.description: Submit affidavit declaring that the beneficiary family does not own a pucca house anywhere in India.

steps.title: Register on PMAY-MIS portal
steps.description: Submit Aadhaar numbers of all family members, existing house rent proof, and bank IFSC details.

steps.title: Geo-tagging and civic survey
steps.description: Municipal survey team visits current dwelling to conduct geo-tagged photo verification.

steps.title: Interest subsidy credit / Flat allotment
steps.description: Central government releases interest subsidy directly to home loan bank account or allocates municipal housing unit.
